019/**
020 * Wrapper to handle inventory/fake inventory/custom inventory etc.
021 */
022public interface InventoryWrapper extends Iterable<ItemStack> {
023
024  /**
025   * Change items in the inventory by index Set the item-stack type to air or amount to zero will
026   * remove it
027   * <p>
028   * It's not thread-safe, please use that in main-thread
029   *
030   * @see ItemChanger
031   */
032  default void changeItem(final ItemChanger itemChanger) {
033
034    final InventoryWrapperIterator iterator = iterator();
035    int index = 0;
036    boolean shouldContinue = true;
037    while(shouldContinue && iterator.hasNext()) {
038      final ItemStack itemStack = iterator.next();
039      if(itemStack == null) {
040        continue;
041      }
042
043      final ItemStack original = itemStack.clone();
044      shouldContinue = itemChanger.changeItem(index, itemStack);
045      if(itemStack.getAmount() == 0 || itemStack.getType() == Material.AIR) {
046        iterator.setCurrent(null);
047
048      } else if(!original.equals(itemStack)) {
049        // only update when changed
050        iterator.setCurrent(itemStack);
051      }
052      index++;
053    }
054  }
055
056  /**
057   * Return the iterator for this inventory It's not thread-safe, please use that in main-thread
058   *
059   * @return the iterator for this inventory
060   */
061  @NotNull
062  @Override
063  InventoryWrapperIterator iterator();

065  /**
066   * Clear the inventory
067   */
068  void clear();
069
070  /**
071   * Create an Inventory snapshot (including Empty slots). QuickShop-Hikari will shoot a snapshot
072   * for inventory used for purchase failure rollback. Note: provide an invalid snapshot will cause
073   * rollback break whole Inventory! WARNING: High recommend to override this method, default method
074   * doing by badways and low-performance, may mess up Inventory item order.
075   *
076   * @return The inventory contents for snapshot use.
077   */
078  @NotNull
079  default ItemStack[] createSnapshot() {
080
081    Logger.getLogger("QuickShop-Hikari").log(Level.WARNING, "InventoryWrapper provider " + getWrapperManager().getClass().getName() + " didn't override default InventoryWrapper#createSnapshot method, it may cause un-excepted behavior like item missing, mess order and heavy hit performance! Please report this issue to InventoryWrapper provider plugin author!");
082    final List<ItemStack> contents = new ArrayList<>();
083    for(final ItemStack stack : this) {
084      if(stack == null) {
085        continue;
086      }
087      contents.add(stack.clone());
088    }
089    return contents.toArray(new ItemStack[0]);
090  }

182  /* Need to test the following before implementation, but I think it's a better impl.
183  */
184  @NotNull
185  default ItemRemoveResult removeItem(final ItemStack... itemStacks) {
186
187    final Map<Integer, ItemStack> leftovers = new HashMap<>();
188    final Map<Integer, ItemStack> removed = new HashMap<>();
189
190    for (int i = 0; i < itemStacks.length; i++) {
191
192      final ItemStack requested = itemStacks[i];
193      int remaining = requested.getAmount();
194
195      final InventoryWrapperIterator iterator = iterator();
196
197      int iteratorSlot = 0;
198      while (remaining > 0 && iterator.hasNext()) {
199        final ItemStack current = iterator.next();
200
201        if (current == null) {
202          iteratorSlot++;
203          continue;
204        }
205
206        if (!QuickShopAPI.getInstance().getItemMatcher().matches(requested, current)) {
207          iteratorSlot++;
208          continue;
209        }
210
211        final ItemStack currentClone = current.clone();
212
213        final int amount = Math.min(remaining, current.getAmount());
214
215        current.setAmount(current.getAmount() - amount);
216        currentClone.setAmount(amount);
217        iterator.setCurrent(current);
218
219        remaining -= amount;
220        if (amount > 0) {
221
222          removed.merge(iteratorSlot, currentClone, (existing, added) -> existing.add(added.getAmount()));
223        }
224        iteratorSlot++;
225      }
226
227      if (remaining > 0) {
228
229        final ItemStack leftoverStack = requested.clone();
230        leftoverStack.setAmount(remaining);
231        leftovers.put(i, leftoverStack);
232      }
233    }
234
235    return new ItemRemoveResult(leftovers, removed);
236  }
237
238  /**
239   * Rollback Inventory by a snapshot. Snapshot can be created by InventoryWrapper#createSnapshot()
240   * WARNING: High recommend to override this method, default method doing by badways and
241   * low-performance, may mess up Inventory item order.
242   *
243   * @param snapshot The inventory content snapshot
244   *
245   * @return The result of rollback.
246   */
247  default boolean restoreSnapshot(@NotNull final ItemStack[] snapshot) {
248
249    Logger.getLogger("QuickShop-Hikari").log(Level.WARNING, "InventoryWrapper provider " + getWrapperManager().getClass().getName() + " didn't override default InventoryWrapper#restoreSnapshot method, it may cause un-excepted behavior like item missing, mess order and heavy hit performance! Please report this issue to InventoryWrapper provider plugin author!");
250    final InventoryWrapperIterator it = iterator();
251    while(it.hasNext()) {
252      it.remove();
253    }
254    final Map<Integer, ItemStack> result = addItem(snapshot);
255    return result.isEmpty();
256  }
257
258  /**
259   * Add specific items from inventory
260   *
261   * @param itemStacks items to add
262   *
263   * @return The map of containing item index and itemStack itself which is not fit
264   */
265  @NotNull
266  default Map<Integer, ItemStack> addItem(final ItemStack... itemStacks) {
267
268    if(itemStacks.length == 0) {
269      return Collections.emptyMap();
270    }
271    final InventoryWrapperIterator iterator = iterator();
272    final Map<Integer, ItemStack> integerItemStackMap = new HashMap<>();
273    AddProcess:
274    for(int i = 0; i < itemStacks.length; i++) {
275      final ItemStack itemStackToAdd = itemStacks[i];
276      while(iterator.hasNext()) {
277        final ItemStack itemStack = iterator.next();
278        if(itemStack == null) {
279          iterator.setCurrent(itemStackToAdd);
280          itemStackToAdd.setAmount(0);
281          continue AddProcess;
282        } else {
283          if(itemStack.isSimilar(itemStackToAdd)) {
284            final int couldAdd = itemStack.getMaxStackSize() - Math.min(itemStack.getMaxStackSize(), itemStack.getAmount());
285            final int actuallyAdd = Math.min(itemStackToAdd.getAmount(), couldAdd);
286            itemStack.setAmount(itemStack.getAmount() + actuallyAdd);
287            final int needsNow = itemStackToAdd.getAmount() - actuallyAdd;
288            itemStackToAdd.setAmount(needsNow);
289            iterator.setCurrent(itemStack);
290            if(needsNow == 0) {
291              continue AddProcess;
292            }
293          }
294        }
295      }
296      if(itemStackToAdd.getAmount() != 0) {
297        integerItemStackMap.put(i, itemStackToAdd);
298      }
299    }
300    return integerItemStackMap;
301  }
302
303  /**

306   * @param itemStacks the contents you want to set
307   */
308  void setContents(ItemStack[] itemStacks);
309
310  /**
311   * Change the item from Inventory
312   */
313  interface ItemChanger {
314
315    /**
316     * Do item change action in the inventory
317     *
318     * @param index     the item index in the inventory, start from zero
319     * @param itemStack the item in this index
320     *
321     * @return If continue to change items in the next index
322     */
323    boolean changeItem(int index, ItemStack itemStack);
324  }
